## What changes for users?

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link a related issue if available.

## Verification

List checks run, browser versions tested, and any unverified behavior.
Use synthetic data; do not attach cookie exports or live tokens.

## Review notes

Call out permission, storage, import/export, or cookie-identity changes.
Update docs and CHANGELOG.md when behavior changes, and preserve attribution
for copied or adapted material.
